claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 µM, parachlorophenol is expected to be largely inactive against human cancer cell lines, as its known cytotoxicity in dental and other non-cancer cells occurs at much higher concentrations and it lacks a specific anticancer mechanism.
